question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Trivial**
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Important .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Trivial**" means something of little importance or value.
 
• To find the antonym, we need to select the word that conveys the opposite meaning, i.e., something significant or of great importance.
 
• Among the given options:
 
 
• **Option 1: Insignificant** - Synonym of "trivial," meaning something unimportant. (Incorrect)
 
• **Option 2: Minor** - Similar in meaning to "trivial," also meaning less important. (Incorrect)
 
• **Option 3: Important** - Opposite of "trivial," meaning something of great significance. (Correct)
 
• **Option 4: Commonplace** - Similar to "trivial," meaning something ordinary or not special. (Incorrect)
 
 

Correct Answer: **Important**, as it is the most appropriate antonym of "Trivial".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Antonyms are words that have opposite meanings. For example:
 
 
• **Bright** and **Dark**
 
• **Fast** and **Slow**
 
 
 
• Synonyms are words with similar meanings. For example:
 
 
• **Happy** and **Joyful**
 
• **Trivial** and **Insignificant**
